name: Scientific and Research Institute Ferrit-Domen
aliases: SCIENTIFIC AND RESEARCH INSTITUTE FERRIT DOMEN

evidence.summary: The US Treasury names Scientific And Research Institute Ferrit Domen among the Russia-based subsidiaries of Ruselectronics that OFAC designated in June 2022. It describes Ruselectronics as a holding company owned by Rostec, which it calls the cornerstone of Russia’s defence and industrial sectors, that unites Russia’s radio-electronic industry. OFAC lists it as linked to Ruselectronics, in Saint Petersburg.
It belongs to Ruselectronics, a holding company of the Russian state corporation Rostec.

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Sanctions Nearly 100 Targets in Putin’s War Machine, Prohibits Russian Gold Imports (28 June 2022)
